name: hirokata
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins for enhanced development workflows

plugins.name: software
plugins.description: Requirements-to-implementation workflow with 8-phase clean architecture, automated planning, adaptive parallel execution, intelligent conventional commit generation, and comprehensive requirements documentation.

plugins.name: project-management
plugins.description: Project management plugin for orchestrating requests, delegating work to agents, and managing project workspace structure.

plugins.name: session-tracker
plugins.description: Tracks and summarizes Claude Code work sessions. Say 'end session' to log git activity for the past 28 hours, or 'daily summary' to generate a cross-project grouped report.

plugins.name: guild
plugins.description: Continuous agent orchestration system. Manages requirements, planning, parallel development, test planning, unit & integration testing, and review through a directory-based ticket board driven by a deterministic CLI, with crash-safe session resume, automated agent chains, a Svelte/SvelteKit specialist developer agent, and an independent QA discipline. Say 'check in' to start a work session.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: PhD-level multi-perspective research inspired by Stanford's STORM. The 'storm research' skill orchestrates five expert persona agents (practitioner, skeptic, economist, historian, academic), maps their contradictions, synthesizes a cited briefing, and red-teams the result. Say 'storm research <topic>' to start.
